Workpaper WP-015
1) The auditor examined the incident ticketing system's access control log for user accounts with the "Signal-Analysis-Admin" role; the review revealed that three accounts had elevated privileges granted without documented supervisor approval; the exception remains open regarding the retroactive validation of these privilege escalations.
2) The auditor inspected the RF interference database schema for the "signal_origin" and "geolocation_vector" fields; the inspection confirmed that these fields lack mandatory input validation and allow null values; the exception remains open concerning the potential for unauthorized manipulation of origin data.
3) The auditor tested the delivery drone fleet's telemetry transmission logs against the standard navigation protocol specifications; the testing showed that 14% of recorded routes deviated from expected trajectories without corresponding logged fault codes; the exception remains open regarding the reconciliation of unexplained route deviations.
4) The auditor compared the customer complaint register entries mentioning "package interception" with the physical warehouse security camera footage for the same period; the comparison identified a mismatch where complaints referenced timestamps not present in the archived video files; the exception remains open pending recovery of the missing video segments.
5) The auditor reviewed the third-party RF equipment vendor contract and associated compliance certificates; the review found that the vendor's FCC Part 15 compliance certification expired 90 days prior to the audit period start date; the exception remains open regarding the verification of continued lawful operation during the gap.
